scripts.dev: npm run build -w @reelops/shared && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs run dev -w @reelops/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @reelops/shared && npm run build -w @reelops/web && npm run build -w @reelops/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @reelops/shared && npm run typecheck -w @reelops/web && npm run typecheck -w @reelops/worker
scripts.worker: npm run build -w @reelops/shared && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs run dev -w @reelops/worker
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.test:video: npm run build -w @reelops/shared && npm run build -w @reelops/worker && node scripts/smoke-video.mjs
